message.text:
Cross Tantegel Moor
and head to Tantegel.

Find the man in Tantegel
who knows about curses.

Head to Tantegel Castle
and speak to the king.

Cross North Tantegel Moor
and head to Erdrick's Hollow.

Fetch Goopy from the
curse researcher in Tantegel.

Return to Tantegel Castle
and thank the king.

Head east
and search for Princess Gwaelin.

Deliver Princess Gwaelin
safely home to Tantegel Castle.

To Be Continued
While you're waiting, why not explore a bit and unlock all the secret spots?

Return to Tantegel Castle
and speak to the king.

Pass through the Forest of Kol
and head to the Shrine of Rain.

Return to Tantegel Castle
and speak to the king.

Cross Galenholm Cape
and head to Cantlin in the far south.
Speak to the innkeeper in Cantlin.
Speak to the elder in Cantlin.
Play ‘Defend Cantlin’.

To Be Continued
While you're waiting, why not explore a bit and unlock all the secret spots?
Speak to the wandering warrior in Cantlin.
Find the southernmost region.
Return to Cantlin.

Open a door in Cantlin
and speak to the weapon shop owner.
Speak to the wandering warrior in Cantlin.
Play ‘Drive Back the Dragonlord's Army’.
Return to Cantlin.

To Be Continued
While you're waiting, why not explore a bit and unlock all the secret spots?
Return to Tantegel Castle.
You've reached the end of the story, but you can still explore this world!
